title: Next-release program: root review of W1-W4 studies and section-6 scenarios
scope: Root operated the new and earlier composition studies through their actual controls in an isolated copy of the private app (separate port, package tarballs from an --allow-dirty build, LayerControls patched only in that copy to render inspectorItems). Reviewed: option-by-option sweeps of every select, randomized operation of every control, an all-sliders-at-maximum corner test, structural sweeps, and layered pairs in both orders. The twelve roadmap section-6 scenarios were composed from merged studies with their decisive edits.
findings: Defects found and fixed include: graph-roles forest off canvas, vanishing route and arrow hairballs; branch-ornament looped default; data-scores opaque column selects; path-typography upside-down default; chemotactic-trails slider max above hard limit; slider corners refused or slow in eleven studies (now admitted and within about 2.5 s CPU); surface-growth sphere refusal; collision-scores emitter refusal; a planar-kernel offset convergence defect; wall-clock assertions removed from tests.
limits: The real authenticated Studio was not available; layered compositions used the equivalent SVG surface, not Studio. Sweeps are of selects and controls, not every numeric combination. Layered scenarios are composition checks, not artist-quality acceptance. The control audit for laplacian-fronts and pattern-competition was run separately. No release was cut; packages are unpublished local artifacts. Images are ignored files linked in place.
